item.title: NimConf 2026: Dates Announced, Registrations Open
item.description:
📝 You can see all the talks from previous years on YouTube: NimConf 2020 NimConf 2021 NimConf 2022 NimConf 2024 Important Dates Talk proposals are accepted until May 10, 2026. Talk recordings must be submitted before June 7, 2026. NimConf 2026 will be held on June 20, 2026.

item.title: The exponential curve behind open source backlogs
item.description:
📝 A 2024 Tidelift survey found that 60% of open source maintainers have quit or considered quitting. Jellyfin is just where I ran into it. That is not a temporary backlog, that is just what the system does at this load.
🔗 Read more: https://armanckeser.com/writing/jellyfin-flow
